Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by prematurely concluding the solution without gathering the necessary data. In Step 1, the Planner stated, "The likely farthest-west birth city among presidents is Honolulu, HI... The easternmost birth city among presidents is likely in Massachusetts... The pair most plausibly farthest apart is Honolulu, HI and an eastern Massachusetts city...". This was a hallucination and a logical leap made without first verifying the actual list of birth cities or their longitudes. The Planner failed to execute the core task of gathering the dataset, relying instead on assumptions that led to an incorrect answer (Braintree/Yorba Linda instead of the correct pair involving Honolulu).
